parts.t: Investor Alert! 4 BED, 1 BATH, 1,523 SQFT HOUSE + SHOP on two titled lots (11,238 sq.ft.) zoned RM3 – allows 4-storey buildings, townhomes, duplexes & apartments. Home still needs work. Upgrades include plumbing, electrical, windows, flooring, hot water tank, fireplace & engineer-approved foundation. 24x28 shop has new roof. Occupancy granted by City of Princeton. 2024 BC Assessment: $552,400. BESIDE SAVE ON FOODS!
